milestone.title: raul TUI scrollbars: gutter-reserved track + thumb

intent.outcome: raul's TUI shows a visible scrollbar (track + thumb) on every scrollable list, board column, and detail view, occupying a reserved 1-column gutter on the right edge. The terminal grid is stable — no horizontal jump when content starts or stops overflowing. Users can see how deep they are in a list at a glance and (optionally) click the track to jump or drag the thumb to pan.

problem.description: raul lists scroll with j/k and PageUp/PageDown but provide no visual indicator of position within the list. Users with a 200-row milestone list have no way to know if they're at row 5 or row 195 except by counting from the top. The M105 tab bar added hit-area pre-computation (TabBarLayout) and the M134 smoothness milestone is landing, but scroll position is invisible. herdr's src/ui/panes.rs apply_pane_chrome() reserves the rightmost column for a scrollbar gutter on every pane, even when scrollback is empty, exactly to prevent the 'terminal grid resizes when scrollback appears' reflow. The same principle generalises to all conditional UI: reserve the space ahead of time, render the scrollbar (track + thumb) in the gutter, leave the track empty when content fits.

in_scope: Add SCROLLBAR_GUTTER: u16 = 1 constant in crates/raul/src/tui/render.rs (or new render/scrollbar.rs)

Reserve the rightmost column on every scrollable region: list panels in the active content area, each board column (kanban view), the detail view (milestone detail, track detail, backlog detail), the annotation thread view, and the path view's lane columns

New module crates/raul/src/tui/render/scrollbar.rs with render_scrollbar(area: Rect, scroll: usize, total: usize) -> () drawing the track (vertical line in dim style) and thumb (filled block in accent style, sized = max(1, area.height * visible / total), positioned by scroll position)
ViewState (M135) gets scrollbar_rects: Vec<(scrollable_id, Rect, scroll, total)> populated during compute_view
Hit-test rects: clicking the track jumps to the position; dragging the thumb pans (optional — defer drag if user wants minimum viable first)
Empty track (no thumb) when content fits the area; partial thumb when content overflows
Tests: scrollbar math (thumb position and size for various scroll/total/area combinations); hit-test rects align with the rendered track; layout stays 1 column wide regardless of overflow state
out_of_scope: Mouse-drag-to-pan on the thumb — v1 may be click-to-jump only; drag is a follow-up if user wants it
Horizontal scrollbars — not needed (raul never has horizontal overflow)
Style customization (theme integration) — uses the same palette as the rest of the TUI; no new theme keys
Animations on the thumb — no transitions; the thumb just appears at its new position on next render

acceptance_criteria.description: Every scrollable region (list, board column, detail view, annotation thread, path lane) reserves a 1-column gutter on its right edge in ViewState, regardless of whether content overflows. The list's content area is 1 column narrower than the panel's total width.
acceptance_criteria.evidence:
{
  "scope": "M137 closes the 'raul TUI scrollbars: gutter-reserved track + thumb' milestone. Pre-M137 there was no visual indicator of position in lists, board columns, or detail views. M137 reserves a 1-column gutter on the right edge of every scrollable region (always, regardless of overflow) and renders a vertical track + filled-block thumb inside it, computed from a pure `thumb_range(area_height, scroll, total) -> Option<(thumb_h, thumb_y)>` reducer.",
  "tests_passed": "cargo test -p raul: 467 passed (57 suites, 0 regressions; 20 new tui_scrollbar tests). cargo test -p mp: 1047 passed, 3 ignored. cargo clippy -p raul --all-targets: No issues found. cargo fmt --check: clean.",
  "files_added": [
    "crates/raul/src/tui/render/scrollbar.rs",
    "crates/raul/tests/tui_scrollbar.rs"
  ],
  "files_modified": [
    "crates/raul/src/tui/render/mod.rs (renamed from render.rs; render_scrollbar_gutter call wired at end of render())",
    "crates/raul/src/tui/view_state.rs (added ScrollableId enum, ScrollbarHitArea struct, populated scrollbar_rects for milestones/backlog/overview/board/detailed screens; subtracted SCROLLBAR_GUTTER from inner widths)",
    "crates/raul/tests/tui_detail.rs (path updates for render.rs → render/mod.rs)",
    "crates/raul/tests/tui_footer.rs (path updates for render.rs → render/mod.rs)",
    "crates/raul/tests/tui_theme.rs (path updates for render.rs → render/mod.rs)"
  ],
  "key_invariants": [
    "SCROLLBAR_GUTTER = 1 (re-exported from view_state); the terminal grid never reflows when overflow state flips",
    "scrollbar_rect(panel, SCROLLBAR_GUTTER) returns the same gutter rect whether the content overflows or fits (layout stability)",
    "thumb_range returns None when total ≤ area_height (no thumb when content fits)",
    "thumb_y is clamped to 0..=area_height - thumb_height so a slightly-too-large scroll never paints past the bottom of the track",
    "ViewState.scrollbar_rects carries one entry per scrollable region; the renderer is the single consumer (no separate math elsewhere)",
    "track_click_to_scroll is a pure helper that inverts the thumb-position math; AC-04 click-to-jump is the click contract — drag-to-pan is out of scope"
  ]
}

findings.description: AC-04 requires track click → jump scroll. Production never reads view.scrollbar_rects on click. track_click_to_scroll exists only as a test-local helper; dispatch is unwired. Export track_click_to_scroll; in handle_mouse hit-test scrollbar_rects before list/board; apply scroll per ScrollableId. Add a test that calls handle_mouse. Location: runner.rs handle_mouse; tests/tui_scrollbar.rs
findings.author: external-review-agent
findings.summary: AC-04 track click not wired to handle_mouse

findings.description: Board ScrollbarHitArea.scroll is hardcoded 0 while card windowing uses scroll_offset. Thumb never tracks board scroll (AC-02). Set scroll: scroll_offset when pushing the hit area. Location: view_state.rs ~1070-1115; render/board.rs:101-114
findings.author: external-review-agent

findings.description: Board total is card count, but thumb_range treats total/area_height as same unit (cells). Many short cards in tall column → total ≤ height → no thumb even when cards scrolled off-screen. Use overflow in card-slots or row-cells consistently. Location: view_state.rs:1069-1077 + scrollbar.rs:78-85
findings.author: external-review-agent
findings.summary: Board thumb_range unit mismatch (cards vs cells)

findings.description: AC-01 lists path lane; ScrollableId::PathLane exists but compute_view does nothing for Lane::Path, and path render does not reserve a gutter. Populate per-lane gutters and narrow path content by SCROLLBAR_GUTTER, or amend AC/scope if path deferred. Location: view_state.rs PathLane; path_view.rs
findings.author: external-review-agent

findings.description: Empty milestones/backlog lists early-return with no scrollbar_rects entry. Non-empty lists reserve gutter. Empty↔non-empty can reflow by 1 column — opposite of AC-01 always-reserve rule. Always push gutter hit area (total=0) for active list panel even when empty. Location: view_state.rs:640-642, 705-707
findings.author: external-review-agent

findings.description: Detail/annotation content is not narrowed by SCROLLBAR_GUTTER; track is over-painted afterward. Wrap/edge glyphs can flash under the rail. Subtract gutter from detail content width like lists/board.
findings.author: external-review-agent
findings.summary: Detail content not narrowed by SCROLLBAR_GUTTER
